house_presidential_votes.description: 2024 presidential candidate votes tabulated on the 2024 and 2026 House maps

historical_governor_approval.publisher: Matthew M. Singer, State Executive Approval Dataset v1, UNC Dataverse
historical_governor_approval.transform: Selected state, year, quarter, smoothed approval, smoothed disapproval, and three-quarter validity columns from the public Stata file. The model uses quarter 3 of each historical election year.

current_governor_approval.transform: Extracted state and net approval from the publisher's publicly embedded chart and recorded the survey end date. No values were imputed.
current_governor_approval.limitation: This public chart was the latest complete state table accessible at the retrieval date; it is older than the September 2026 nowcast.
